pr_title: [Refactor] decouple flashcomm and shared expert dp
source_quote:
![high]
Using `torch.chunk` on `hidden_states` when `original_num_tokens` is `0` (e.g., during empty prompt/generation steps or dummy runs) will return a tuple of length 1. Accessing `[self.moe_config.tp_rank]` (where `tp_rank > 0`) will raise an `IndexError: tuple index out of range`.
> Additionally, using `F.pad` might raise a `NameError` if `F` is not imported as `torch.nn.functional` in this file.
> Using `torch.tensor_split` is much safer because it always returns exactly `tp_size` chunks (some of which may be empty) and avoids the `IndexError`. Using `torch.nn.functional.pad` is also safer as `torch` is guaranteed to be imported.

rule.description: 在 MoE/shared expert 的 token 分片逻辑中，按 `tp_rank` 从分片结果取对应 rank 的 chunk 时，必须用 `torch.tensor_split(tensor, tp_size, dim=0)[tp_rank]` 而非 `torch.chunk(tensor, tp_size)[tp_rank]`。`torch.chunk` 在输入为 0 token（空 prompt/generation step/dummy run）时只返回长度 1 的 tuple，`tp_rank > 0` 时会 `IndexError: tuple index out of range`。`torch.tensor_split` 总是返回恰好 `tp_size` 个 chunk（部分可为空），安全处理 0 token 边界。同时 `F.pad` 必须确保已 `import torch.nn.functional as F`，或用全限定 `torch.nn.functional.pad`。
checkpoints: 识别 `torch.chunk(tensor, n)[index]` 模式，特别是 index 为 `tp_rank`/`rank_in_group` 时
确认输入 tensor 是否可能为 0 元素（空 prompt、dummy run、generation step）
改用 `torch.tensor_split(tensor, n, dim=...)[index]`，总是返回 n 个 chunk
确认 `F.pad` / `torch.nn.functional.pad` 已 import，避免 NameError
pad_size 计算用 `(tp_size - num_tokens % tp_size) % tp_size`，0 token 时结果为 0（不 pad）

antipattern.code:
class SharedExpertModule:
    """Shared expert module for MoE."""

    def _prepare_local_shared_expert_dp_input(
        self,
        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """Prepare input for local shared expert DP."""
        original_num_tokens = hidden_states.shape[0]
        # ❌ torch.chunk 在 0 token 时返回长度 1 的 tuple
        # [tp_rank] (tp_rank>0) → IndexError: tuple index out of range
        # ❌ F.pad 若未 import → NameError
        hidden_states = torch.chunk(
            hidden_states, self.moe_config.tp_size, dim=0
        )[self.moe_config.tp_rank]
        return hidden_states

pattern.code:
# ✅ 文件顶部已 import: import torch.nn.functional as F
class SharedExpertModule:
    """Shared expert module for MoE."""

    def _prepare_local_dp_input(
        self,
        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, tuple[int, int]]:
        """Prepare input for local shared expert DP."""
        original_num_tokens = hidden_states.shape[0]
        # See parallel_mode(): moe_config.tp_size describes routed experts in
        # EP, while this token split follows the shared-expert TP group.
        tp_group = self.moe_config.tp_group
        tp_size = tp_group.world_size
        pad_size = (tp_size - original_num_tokens % tp_size) % tp_size
        if pad_size > 0:
            hidden_states = F.pad(hidden_states, (0, 0, 0, pad_size))  # ✅ F 已 import
        # ✅ tensor_split 总是返回 tp_size 个 chunk（部分可为空）
        hidden_states = torch.tensor_split(
            hidden_states,
            tp_size,
            dim=0,
        )[tp_group.rank_in_group]
        return hidden_states, (original_num_tokens, pad_size)
